caption: The drawing depicts two adjacent rectangular panels that each feature a stylized tree with a thick trunk and numerous curved branches, each bearing evenly spaced round fruits or flowers. The left panel has a dark blue background with light gray design elements, and the right panel has a light gray background with dark blue design elements, creating a mirrored effect. In the left panel, under the tree, there is a human figure with raised arms to the right of the trunk, and a small animal that resembles a dog to the left of the trunk. In the right panel, under the tree, there are two seated monkey-like animals facing each other, one on either side of the trunk. Both trees are surrounded by smaller, similarly stylized vegetation elements and birds perched in the upper branches and in the background. The overall color scheme is restricted to the contrasting shades of dark blue and light gray. The drawing is situated on a plain, light-colored background.
